_note: Variable catalogue for Detective mode. power_param is the NASA POWER parameter name to request; the data worker confirms which are live. 'stub' fields only drive the synthetic preview series and are never shown as results.

variables.name: Air temperature
variables.one_line: How warm the air is about two metres above the ground, where a weather station thermometer sits.

variables.name: Rainfall
variables.one_line: How much rain and snow-melt equivalent fell, averaged per day.
variables.source: MERRA-2 corrected precipitation, via NASA POWER

variables.name: Sunlight reaching the ground
variables.one_line: How much of the Sun's energy reaches the surface under real skies, clouds included.

variables.name: Wind speed
variables.one_line: How fast the air moves, measured ten metres above the ground.
variables.source: MERRA-2 wind at 10 m, via NASA POWER

variables.name: Water vapour near the ground
variables.one_line: How much water is held in the air as invisible vapour, as grams per kilogram of air.
variables.source: MERRA-2 specific humidity at 2 m, via NASA POWER

variables.name: Air pressure
variables.one_line: The weight of the air above you, at the surface.
variables.source: MERRA-2 surface pressure, via NASA POWER

variables.name: Soil wetness
variables.one_line: How wet the top layer of soil is, from 0 (bone dry) to 1 (soaked).
variables.source: GEOS surface soil wetness, via NASA POWER

variables.name: Smoke and haze (aerosol optical depth)
variables.one_line: How much smoke, dust and haze blocks sunlight in the air column. Higher means hazier skies.

seasons.name: Wet season, northern tropics (Jun to Sep)
